skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals a 3-hit combo to a single target for 120% ATK Direct DMG.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals Specialized Direct DMG equal to 500% of the target's HP to all enemies (affected only by advanced DMG modifiers), ignoring 45% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and penetrating [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding]. Each cast of the Ultimate increases this unit's Ultimate DMG by an additional 15% (max 2 stacks). After the first Ultimate cast, if an enemy on the field breaks out of the [Ultimate Unyielding] state, Silverfang & Bomb unleash a 5-hit [Void Fist] combo on that target for Specialized Direct DMG equal to 600% of the target's HP (once per turn).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Additionally grants all allies +35% [Arena DMG Increase] and reduces all enemies' [Arena DMG Reduction] by 35% (cannot be dispelled). Specialized Direct DMG 500% > 700%; ignores [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction] 45% > 60%; each cast increases Ultimate DMG 15% > 20%; [Void Fist] combo DMG 600% > 800%.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains +20 Max HP. At the start of battle, gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. Permanently removes enemy [Energy Conversion], grants all allies immunity to [Energy Pressure], and prevents all enemies from recovering [Specialized HP].

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc:
Permanently increases own Max HP by 60%. At the start of the battle, grants self [Increased DMG from Resistance] and [Reduced DMG from Resistance]. When allies HP/[Specialized HP] take DMG, this DMG is reduced by 99%, and 99% of the original damage is converted into [Energy Resilience] (the total amount of [Energy Resilience] gained in this way is at most 28 times the original Max HP of Silverfang & Bomb. This effect and [Resurrection] can only be active at one time. Once [Energy Resilience] reaches its Max, the DMG Reduction effect will no longer be effective).
[Increased DMG from Resistance]: Increases damage dealt by 30% and increases further to 1.5 times when the original health is higher than the attacker's. [Reduced DMG from Resistance]: Reduces damage taken by 30%, and increases futher to 1.5 times when the original health is higher than the attacker's.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Increase own max HP 60% > 80% Converts 10% of the [Energy Resilience] gained by allies into [Specialized HP] (self-conversion rate increased by an additional 50%) [Increased DMG from Resistance]+[Reduced DMG from Resistance]: 30% > 50%, Increases further 1.5 > 1.7

The PvP tier's unique health bar stacks on top of regular health, must also be depleted, and can be restored independently.
